reviews.text: 正如游戏名《西部枪手》，这是以西部枪手为主角的枪战对决游戏。最核心的玩法就是其内容轻度但在形式上也有一丝丝拟真的战斗机制。玩家以斜45度角的方式与各路敌人展开对决，每回合出手前都需要在左轮手枪中装配子弹，很多子弹有额外的效果，如吸血、破甲等等，角色还能获得诸多的强化BUFF，因此具备肉鸽属性。游戏甚至还带有一些克苏鲁元素，微恐而已。此外跟引导旁白对着干会获得相应成就。 [quote]关注「 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/42276832//]鸿源鉴游组」 [/url] [/quote] [u][b] 会当逢佳游，始可见鸿源。 [/b][/u]
教程关箭头不知为什么变的特别大，以及初始小怪偷子弹还是太超标了呃啊，在碰上加50盾的前提下前期跟本打不过（x-x） 还有这招

[h1]我成为西部枪手的那些日子！[/h1] [h3]游戏内容[/h3] 克苏鲁元素加西部元素的回合制肉鸽游戏，以牛仔射击，对枪来进行武器对决的形式来进行回合制战斗，还可以搭配不同的战利品，与不同的子弹组合，来构筑属于你自己的流派，核心特色就是通过6个子弹塞进一把特制的左轮里面，根据敌人的攻击方式来进行相对应的反应，机制有趣，并不是很吓人，Boss 战的挑战还是比较有难度的，需要思考该怎么打。价格便宜，喜欢的可以试试！ 我一玩这游戏，就发现了三个问题，第一，如果不按引导来的话，就会强制 game over，何意味？新手教程连这点耐心都没有吗，第二次玩的时候，莫名其妙地就五发子弹，然后就不断地点，被强制失败游戏了，左键开枪不能直接点的，一定要点那个图标的，手感真的很差好吧。本作的剧情，或者说打了3周目或者以上的话，没有新功能和剧情。希望能不断更新吧。 制作组还在持续的更新，卖9块钱还是比较良心的，目前处于抢先体验阶段，后续也会加入其他三名角色、强化效果以及更多的故事线吧。主要我还是希望优化方向是更多的肉鸽元素的内容加入以及路线选择吧，就像就跟杀戮尖塔一样的地图，我觉得还是挺不错的，而不是通关一关以后， 直接给我们三个方向。如果喜欢肉鸽的话，9块钱可以买来尝试一下。 [quote]漫话漫谈，期待关注:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44551694/]写生漫话家[/url] ←节约宝贵时间，阅读省流测评~ 欢迎加入漫话家的大家庭:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/14030826]写生漫话家[/url]←共同探讨游戏中的精彩片段，向玩家展现第九艺术的魅力
挺好玩的小型肉鸽游戏，你扮演牛仔通过走地图，和敌人对决/找线索逐步发现这个小镇隐藏的怪物和秘密，就是运气和难度较大，还有关键还要看准时机枪反。
便宜好玩的小游戏，荒野西部题材游戏，回合制肉鸽游戏，枪战爽快干脆，上手门槛低，上班摸鱼时间玩两把，解压又过瘾
期待正式版，很有创意，性价比很高，有点难度，希望能调整下，拼手速元素的肉鸽游戏，期待继续更新内容和修复bug。
买不了吃亏买不了上当，还是挺有意思的，期待完整版和后面的剧情线~
使用左轮手枪进行肉鸽的题材满新颖的，游戏性较高，能够进行枪反让人眼前一亮，期待后续增加更新内容
2D肉鸽，挺好玩的，可选的很多，流派很多，就是稍微有点难，一开始没打过，准备再好好研究研究。
狂野西部回合制对决枪战游戏，各种各样的强化可以搭配，玩法新颖，弹反设置的别有用心。

Developed and published by 比岛礁石, 西部枪手 offers an imaginative take on the roguelike genre by blending classic Western themes with unsettling cosmic horror. Rather than presenting a straightforward tale of gunslingers and frontier justice, the game introduces a world where mysterious supernatural forces threaten every corner of the landscape. This unusual combination creates a memorable setting that stands apart from more traditional roguelikes, giving players the opportunity to explore a dangerous frontier filled with bizarre enemies, eerie locations, and hidden secrets waiting to be uncovered. Combat is built around a clever revolver and ammunition system that places strategy ahead of reflexes. Every encounter requires players to carefully manage different bullet types, selecting the right combination to maximize damage, exploit enemy weaknesses, or apply useful effects during battle. Since every decision influences the outcome of a fight, combat feels deliberate and rewarding instead of relying solely on random chance or repetitive attacks. The turn-based structure encourages thoughtful planning while still maintaining enough unpredictability to keep each battle engaging. Replayability appears to be one of the game's strongest features thanks to its roguelike progression. Randomized encounters, varied upgrades, and numerous enhancement combinations ensure that no two adventures unfold exactly the same way. Players can experiment with different builds that alter their combat style, encouraging repeated runs to discover more effective strategies and powerful synergies. The combination of procedural progression and tactical customization gives the gameplay a satisfying sense of variety while rewarding those willing to adapt to constantly changing circumstances. Beyond its mechanics, 西部枪手 places considerable emphasis on atmosphere and storytelling. The frontier is populated with mysterious characters, strange events, and hints of a larger supernatural mystery that gradually unfolds as players advance. Instead of overwhelming players with lengthy exposition, the narrative allows the setting and encounters to reveal pieces of the world naturally. This approach strengthens the sense of exploration while reinforcing the game's blend of Western adventure and Lovecraft-inspired horror. The dark visual style and unsettling themes help create an environment where danger feels ever-present, making exploration just as compelling as combat. As an Early Access title, the game already demonstrates a solid creative foundation while leaving room for future expansion. The developer has ambitious plans to continue building upon the existing systems and narrative, suggesting that the experience will grow with additional content over time. Although players should expect some areas to evolve throughout development, the current design already showcases an original concept supported by distinctive mechanics and a strong artistic direction. 西部枪手 succeeds in delivering a refreshing interpretation of both the Western and roguelike genres by combining tactical gunplay, meaningful progression, and an intriguing supernatural setting. Its innovative ammunition mechanics, replayable structure, and mysterious atmosphere make it an appealing choice for players looking for something beyond conventional roguelikes. While its full potential will ultimately depend on its continued development, the game already displays enough originality and promise to leave a strong impression. Rating: 6/10

Interesting little game, but the low amount of content fits the game’s minimal price tag, and it’s also broken. The mechanics are similar to those of roguelite games, in which you pick your next stage, which can be either a gunfight against a normal or stronger enemy, a shop where you spend money accumulated from victories, or some other event. The main gameplay revolves around gunfights. The first step is to load the gun by right clicking on bullets. You start with six basic ones, but can gain new bullets by choosing them as a reward for winning a gunfight. The loot or offer is random and limited to three choices. You get to pick one, but you can also spend money to reroll and change the offer. Loot is divided into rarity tiers, visible by the number of bullets underneath each reward. It’s always good to pick something of a higher rarity, but it also depends on the loot because you might need a specific perk instead. Besides new bullets, you can increase critical damage, deal more damage to non human enemies, lower enemy health with parries, and so on. So, back to gunfights. After loading the bullets, you click on the trigger and fire them one by one. However, it’s best to save one in case the enemy attacks with something you can parry. This is indicated by an exclamation point icon that fills up, and you need to shoot at the exact moment it is about to fill completely. If you miss or press too soon, you take damage, but if you time it correctly, you block the attack. There are no surprises when it comes to enemy actions, and you can see what they will do during a round by hovering the mouse cursor over their attack icons. Their actions are performed in the order they are listed, so you always know when they will use an attack you can or cannot parry, raise a shield, or perform something unique. Fortunately, there’s a way to block attacks you cannot parry, and since you can see them before starting a round, you can prepare. This is done by sacrificing a loaded bullet in the chamber by right clicking instead of left clicking, which fires the weapon. Each right click on a bullet adds 10 shield points, and while nothing stops you from using all your bullets to build up shields, it’s usually better to add only enough to block the incoming attack, since its damage is known. So if an attack deals 19 damage, you sacrifice two bullets. This strategy will not take you far because each new enemy deals more damage, meaning you have to sacrifice more bullets to block a single attack. Instead, it’s better to choose the right perks and hope for frequent shop appearances, where you can buy new perks or bullets, or even better, heal and upgrade your bullets to deal more damage. To win a run, you need some luck to get the right events during stage selection. This leads to fights against unique characters who give you key items, which then have to be used during other events to progress the story. The longer it takes to find these characters, the tougher the enemies become. Sadly, when you fight one of the key enemies, the game crashes to the desktop every time you deal the killing blow. Another broken feature is the achievements, although that is not as important. Still, the game offers plenty for its price, and it’s in early access, so there will probably be updates. Even so, it leaves a bad taste in the mouth.

一款小型肉鸽游戏，以西部牛仔为主题背景，探索整个小镇所发生的事情。 以左轮枪为载体，填入各种类型的子弹，打出对应伤害数值，击杀敌人推进剧情。 游戏内容简介明了，在部分场景可以拾取金币，部分npc可以选择击杀或者互动对话进行交易。 区别于其他卡牌肉鸽游戏，该游戏有“枪反”技能，使用得当可以做到不扣血，这是该游戏的一大亮点。 游戏整体难度偏硬核，喜欢该类型的玩家可以一试！
